svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

svg.text: Cut 180 x 110 mm from 3 mm sheet; round the corners about 2 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Heights up from the bottom edge; sideways from the centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Sun shield holes (hot sites): drill 3.3 mm, tap M4; 84 each side, 10 up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lug holes: 5.5 mm, 62 mm each side, 39 up (FieldNode's upper lugs).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Plate clip holes: 5.5 mm, 65 mm each side, 65 and 95 up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rail bolts: 5.5 mm on the centre line, 15 and 85 up, countersunk

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the front so the M5 heads sit flush.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Windows: two 24 x 94, corners R5, 26 to 50 each side, 8 to 102 up;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: cut out to save weight. Deburr.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The top edge is where FieldNode's back plate top edge would be.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: back face on the rail front; enclosure back on its lower 30 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: plate clip holes 130 apart across, 30 apart up.
